mechanics.claim: Once the Spirit Blade arrives, Shen empowers his next 3 basic attacks within 8 seconds to deal bonus magic damage on-hit.
mechanics.quote: empowers his next 3 {{tip|basic attacks}} within 8 seconds to gain {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}

mechanics.claim: Against structures, only the flat damage portion of the empowered attack is applied (the max-health ratio is not).
mechanics.quote: Against {{tip|structures}}, only the flat damage portion is applied.

mechanics.claim: If the Spirit Blade hits at least one enemy champion during its travel, the empowered attacks deal increased bonus damage and additionally grant Shen 50% bonus attack speed.
mechanics.quote: If the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} during the travel, the attacks are further enhanced to deal {{ccs|{{as|'''increased bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and additionally grant '''Shen''' {{sti|as|{{as|50% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}

mechanics.claim: If the Spirit Blade collides with a projectile-intercepting effect it stops in place and Shen does not gain the empowered attacks.
mechanics.quote: The {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} will stop in place upon colliding with {{tip|projectile|projectile-intercepting}} effects. If this occurs, '''Shen''' will not gain the empowered attacks as the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} failed to complete its travel to him.

mechanics.claim: Empowered attacks against monsters deal 100% bonus damage, but total damage is capped.
mechanics.quote: Empowered attacks against {{tip|monsters}} deal 100% '''bonus''' damage, but their '''total''' damage is capped.

mechanics.claim: The Q's cooldown begins on cast, not on the Spirit Blade's return.
